feedback_strategy.baseline: One non-contact post-clutch wheel encoder per side, with measured direction

feedback_strategy.continuous_operation_gate: Either qualified worst permitted clutch+servo+enclosure slip duty, or implemented measured input/output slip and energy shutdown; no current-only or PWM-only claim
feedback_strategy.persistent_fault: Stop both, latch off, deliberate reset/rearm
feedback_strategy.short_shock_clip: May recover without latching only within measured duration/recovery/energy envelope; repeated climbing slip remains unacceptable
feedback_strategy.preferred_reference: Selected non-feedback v1 requires actual pre-clutch reference plus post-clutch reader per side for direct slip comparison; future qualified servo feedback can replace upstream reader.

charging_dock.status: Mechanical and electrical architecture proposal; no purchased pack/charger/contact rating or implemented autodocking
charging_dock.mechanism: Replaceable curved metal pads on rear/lower body, recessed inside drum contour, spring-loaded purchased contacts on dock. Accessible for wiping and unpowered manual docking.
charging_dock.mechanical_capture: Dock wheel pockets locate axle and resist roll-away; separate keyed padded fork engages recessed cassette shoulders to hold body pitch before drive power is removed. Spring contacts do not carry docking impact or vehicle weight.
charging_dock.power_path: Purchased isolated low-voltage supply -> current-limited normally-off dock output -> contacts -> onboard reverse blocking/input protection -> purchased pack-specific charger/power-path -> protected pack. Keep actuator branch separately inhibited while charging.
charging_dock.undocked: Battery must not backfeed exposed pads; verify charger/input isolation, not just a fuse.
charging_dock.dock_enable: Mechanical seat/presence confirmation and correct polarity before enabling; contact loss disables charging. Independent overcurrent/temperature handling; Pi not sole charge regulator.
charging_dock.startup: Dock power restoration stays charge-disabled until presence checks; actuator enable remains off. Charge termination cannot be defeated by computer load: select proper power-path or switch system load off.
charging_dock.undock: Stop charge, verify current removed; verify drive control available before mechanical release; controlled departure. Manual mechanical release and battery disconnect remain accessible.
charging_dock.release: Numeric battery/charger/contact/temperature/force/latency limits and supported docking trials required before energizing contacts; autonomous return requires implemented localization, final alignment and failed-dock handling.

double_helical_fallback.handing: Each gear has opposite-hand halves; mating gears have opposite hand at corresponding axial positions. Mirror left/right complete assembly without breaking mating relationship.
double_helical_fallback.print_concept: One piece per gear with continuous root/hub core and narrow central tooth relief; flat shaft axis vertical. Validate apex/relief support and first-layer compensation.
double_helical_fallback.assembly: Bring pair into mesh before lowering both supported shaft assemblies into open saddles, bridge/lid/wheels removed as needed; prove combined removal sweep. Do not assume a herringbone pair can slide axially apart while meshed.
double_helical_fallback.thrust: Ideal opposite axial forces cancel only with equal half loading. Retain shafts for residual axial load in both directions; no preload through clutch or opposing bearing races.
double_helical_fallback.fixture_gates: Actual involute and root generation, correct hand/phase, backlash over full turn, tooth contact both halves, no binding through reverse, load/temperature/wear/noise, assembly/removal access
